answer: Reaching eligibility takes 50 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. The walnut register is checked at draw time, ridge lists the eligible set, and pearl seals it before the panel is revealed. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
